title: Ban Gioc in a day
summary: One eastern day from Cao Bang city or from a night in Dam Thuy: Ban Gioc, the lit cave, and the pagoda viewpoint. Phia Oac and Pac Bo stay on other days.

stops.name: Ban Gioc
stops.note: The hour on this row is not a published gate time. Come between 10:30 and 15:30 when the water is low. How long you stay is check on arrival.

stops.name: Nguom Ngao
stops.note: About an hour or more for the lit kilometre, about 4 km from the falls. The Ban Thuon branch is a different visit.

stops.name: Truc Lam Ban Gioc
stops.note: A short, steep walk. Under an hour once you are there. Exact minutes are check on arrival.

seoDescription: A Cao Bang day for Ban Gioc, Nguom Ngao, and Truc Lam Ban Gioc. Gate times and fees are check on arrival. The low-water window is 10:30 to 15:30.
